subject.title: fix #93908: [Bug]: [Bug]: Feishu plugin skipping discovery - host reports 2026.5.28 despite 2026.6.8 install

question: Must this PR provide a real npm-global upgrade and post-restart Feishu discovery transcript, or is the focused lifecycle coverage and metadata discovery output sufficient for this compatibility change?
rationale: The code path and regression tests support the fix, but only a maintainer can intentionally accept boundary-level evidence instead of the repository's normal real-behavior proof requirement for an external compatibility-sensitive PR.

options.title: Require real update proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted npm-global upgrade demonstrates installed-target propagation through convergence and successful discovery after restart.

options.title: Accept boundary evidence
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused regression tests and real Feishu metadata discovery output without a complete package-update lifecycle run.
